analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100/200 ($302.33/$258.88) - diagnosing mid-to-long term weak trend.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.99x) + increased confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + meeting conditions for observation.
